title: The Final Terminal
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Quintana, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
